presets.name: Bare
presets.summary: No beard, no glasses, no blush.
presets.description: Three optional components off at once. What is left is the outfit, the hair and the face, which is where most of this style's variety lives anyway.

presets.name: Sepia
presets.summary: Eight groups on one brown ramp.
presets.description: Two mouths and two head pieces are excluded: the tongue mouths and the animal ears carry a printed pink that no color option reaches.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.summary: No hue on any of the eight groups.
presets.description: The style shades every cube face separately, so a set of greys keeps all its depth. Same exclusions as Sepia.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.summary: One blue, four steps of it.
presets.description: Skin, hair and every garment take a step of the same hue. What separates two avatars is the haircut, the outfit shape and the face.

presets.name: Muted
presets.description: The style ships ten shirt colors at full strength. These are the same clothes in tones that sit quietly, which suits a list where a dozen figures appear at once.

presets.name: Electric
presets.description: Only the shirt moves. The style already offers fantasy hair colors, and pairing those with a neon shirt leaves nothing for the eye to settle on.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.summary: Six soft grounds instead of five.
presets.description: Close to what the style ships, with a green added and each color pulled a little further apart, so a row of tiles reads as six choices rather than five near-misses.

presets.name: Bold Pop
presets.description: The five grounds the style ships are all pale. A loud one turns the same figure from a portrait into a poster.

presets.name: Night Shift
presets.description: For dark interfaces. The shirt palette moves to light tones, because the style's charcoal shirts and dark trousers merge into a dark tile.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient behind the figure.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle. The seed still decides which of the two ends up on top, so the light comes from either side across a set.

presets.name: Full Cast
presets.summary: Glasses, beard and blush on everyone.
presets.description: Three optional components turned up. The style ships five pairs of glasses and four beards that most seeds never reach.

presets.name: Close Up
presets.summary: Head and torso, legs cropped away.
presets.description: The full figure is small at avatar sizes and its identity is in the face. This crops to the top two thirds and keeps the hair.

presets.name: Animated
presets.summary: Turns the style's built-in animation on.
presets.description: The animation is off by default and `animation: true` switches it on. `animationSpeed` sets the pace. The motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
